limitations: Stable fixture decoding is not proof of hardware acquisition, host consumption, or communication acceptance.
SDK terminal-boundary snapshot is not continuous state; SnapshotWithoutTxLock does not prove ownership of the pending data.
No PC/device time ordering is inferred without a matched same-boot nonce and explicit uncertainty bounds.
Uncalled API raw_return is unknown, not false.
Boot identity must be generated afresh each firmware startup; a nonzero fixture alone cannot prove entropy.
Stable committed MCU record only; not a continuous physical FIFO or PC consumption proof.
MAVLink CRC and PC/MCU bounded time correlation require independent evaluator input.
The build fingerprint is a diagnostic generation marker, not an artifact digest.
Live exact-image identity depends on the supplied installer verify evidence remaining current.
Endpoint FIFO evidence reaches the native USB transaction boundary but does not prove Windows user-space CDC consumption.
Extended restart and first Ground USB commit records are latched diagnostic events, not continuous hardware state.
Record acquisition PASS does not establish USB completion, communication acceptance, or the 932-parameter throughput goal.
Boot instance comes from the raw record; matching a later PC exchange requires its exact nonce/device sample and independent clock continuity/error bounds.
PC/device causal time ordering is UNKNOWN until the independently bounded exchange is supplied.
Timed path mode observes the first product Heartbeat; acquisition PASS is not product acceptance or physical FIFO proof.
